text:
Maria (Finance): Heads-up — during the last price sheet rollout we saw a handful of legacy customers get a retroactive credit re-applied. I pulled one invoice sample: `INV-2026-0042` shows a -$1,200 'promo credit' line after cutover. Can we confirm whether the grandfathering filter is skipping in the new batching job?
Alex (RevOps): ugh, thanks for flagging. Do you have the customer IDs? I can check cohort flags.
Maria (Finance): Customer is `cust_88kL`. Also saw `cust_23Pq` and `cust_99Xz` in the same set. They should have been grandfathered to legacy rates per cohort mapping v2.
Jamal (Billing): Noted. I can repro locally against the billing replayer. Might be a mapping mismatch between v2 and the price-sheet import. Priya, did the latest price-sheet loader change field names?
Priya (EngProd): We changed `rate_category` -> `pricing_band` in the loader to support new tiers. Loader had a compatibility layer but maybe the mapping for `grandfathered=true` got dropped in the bulk import path. I'll check commits from the deploy last night.
finance-bot: Invoice processor job `invoice-processor-2026-03` completed (run id: rp_20260322_04). Applied 3,102 invoices, 12 failures.
Maria (Finance): @Priya please check whether the `grandfathered` flag is present in the DB after import. If not, we may need to freeze the rollout and re-process affected invoices. :eyes:
Priya (EngProd): On it. Quick check: the SQL upsert uses `pricing_band` but the `legacy_exempt` boolean still maps. I see an edge case where empty strings set the field to NULL which downstream treats as false.
Alex (RevOps): So customers with an empty `legacy_exempt` became eligible for promos. That's consistent with the observed credits. How many customers hit this?
Jamal (Billing): Replayer indicates ~28 invoices across 3 enterprise accounts in the last 6 hours. Mostly big customers — we should estimate revenue impact before any rollback.
Maria (Finance): Please make a conservative exposure estimate. Also want a short rollback plan if the fix requires re-import.
Priya (EngProd): Quick mitigation: update loader to coerce empty -> true for customers in legacy cohort until we push a proper fix. I can patch and roll a hotfix in the next 30m.
Alex (RevOps): If we hotfix the loader, will that prevent future credits but not fix already-processed invoices, right?
Priya (EngProd): Correct. We'll need a reprocess job to generate reversing adjustments for affected invoices. I can add a safety gate that only touches invoices within a window and writes a job manifest.
Jamal (Billing): I can prepare the reversing adj templates. Need list of invoice ids and amounts. Maria — can you confirm priority list of accounts we want to reverse first (high-dollar ones)?
Maria (Finance): Priority: `cust_88kL`, `cust_23Pq`, `cust_99Xz`. If impact > $5k per account, escalate to Legal for notification.
finance-bot: Action item logged: ticket FIN-PR-443 created for rollback/reversal work.
Alex (RevOps): I'll notify account owners with a heads-up and draft communication.
Priya (EngProd): Patch ready, deploying to staging. Will run small dry-run on replayer and post results here.
Maria (Finance): Thanks. Keep the thread updated. If the hotfix looks safe, freeze new price-sheet rollouts until we have a reprocess plan and test signoff. :thumbsup:
Jamal (Billing): Dry-run shows 28 invoices matched and total erroneous credits = $17,340. Reversal templates generated for review.
Alex (RevOps): Yikes. OK — proceeding with account comms and risk checklist.
Priya (EngProd): Staging deployment OK. Loader now treats empty legacy_exempt as true for grandfathered cohort. Will schedule prod hotfix in 10m and then hand over reprocess manifest to billing.
Maria (Finance): Approved to go ahead with hotfix. After prod deploy — confirm by posting a sample invoice id that would have been affected but now preserved correctly.
Priya (EngProd): Prod hotfix complete. Sample `INV-2026-0042` now shows no promo credit line in staging replayer; will hand off manifest.
Jamal (Billing): Received manifest. Starting reversal jobs in low-traffic window. Will post completion ETA.
Maria (Finance): Great work team — keep me posted on completion and customer comms.
Alex (RevOps): Will share the comms draft in #customer-notify for review once reversals are scheduled.
Maria (Finance): Closing the alert here but leave thread open until reversals finish.
